//: The names and versions the frame's packages publish under, and the DSH release they are built against. The CLI ships this file (an app made with init --desktop installs these names and versions), and verify-frame-publish packs exactly these packages: the closure of the frame's rows, nothing else. The owner's naming decision is the `scope` value and the short names; the owner confirmed these names on 2026-11-05, so a rename after the first publish is a new package on npm. A version must equal its package folder's package.json version (the CLI tests check it).

pnpm.//: An app in the frame installed with pnpm: these build scripts run, as they do under npm (packages/cli/src/pnpm-settings.ts). Found by installing a framed app with pnpm 12: dsh-subprocess-local builds its spawn helper, node-pty and koffi their native parts.
